meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude会化身为会议主持人,把用户的每个git工作目录、分支或拉取请求当成独立“成员”,让它们在同一条聊天记录里逐轮发言,比较各自改动并商量出一个整合方案;全程只读、不实际合并,最后Claude会用通俗的话把结论翻译给用户。
howto.when: 当用户要求对多个git工作目录、分支或拉取请求做对比,或希望整理出一份合并方案时触发;Claude会先列出候选清单确认,若候选零或一个则停下建议扩大范围。

say.text: 帮我对这几个工作目录开一次只读站会,给出整合方案。
say.note: 会先列出候选清单请你确认

say.text: 把最近24小时有改动的分支都拉进来,拟一份合并顺序。
say.note: 会按活跃时间筛选工作树

say.text: 带上我的两个拉取请求和main分支做一轮对比,告诉我先处理哪个。
say.note: 每个分支/PR会作为独立成员发言

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each git worktree, branch, or PR becomes an agent in a shared chat room. They talk in rounds to compare changes and agree on one consolidation plan. The room is read-only, no merges happen, and Claude translates the outcome into plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to compare multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs and wants a consolidation plan. Claude lists candidates to confirm first; if zero or one candidate, it stops and suggests widening the scope.

say_en.text: Run a read-only standup across these worktrees and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: It lists candidates for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Pull in all branches touched in the last 24 hours and draft a merge order.
Compare my two PRs and main branch; tell me which to handle first.
say_en.note: Each branch/PR speaks as its own agent.
